title: Enterprise advisory intake & routing playbook for optimization requests
creator: Aisha Malik
description:
This ticket defines a standardized intake and prioritization process for enterprise optimization and advisory requests (non-bug). Focus areas: batching/caching knobs, quantization profiles, routing policies. Goal: reduce SLA friction, triage enterprise requests within SLAs, and provide actionable recommendations that yield measurable cost and latency improvements.

Scope:
- Formalize fields required on intake (workload profile, target SLOs, data sensitivity, throughput patterns, current model & variant, quantization tolerance).
- Build a lightweight scoring rubric to prioritize requests by customer impact, estimated unit savings, risk, and engineering effort.
- Define routing rules: automatic handoff to Runtime team / Dedicated Ops / Private Deployments based on request attributes and enterprise tier.
- Define SLAs: Triage (48h), Advisory report (10 business days for P1 enterprise), Implementation plan (by agreement).
